decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The cumulative effect of the alterations result in a dwelling which fails to relate to the nature, scale and character of the adjacent townscape. The scheme is therefore contrary to Policy ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 of the Unitary Development PLan 1996 and Policies ENV.B.1.1 and H.4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.
description: Following approval of application 01048/212A/P7 for the erection of a semi-detached three bedroom house, details submitted pursuant to condition 3 (development in accordance with the approved plans), for the retention of the following alterations to the scheme: (a) Increase in height of dwelling (b) Erection of flank dormer window (c) Alterations to the appearance of front elevation including front bay and door (d) Insertion of second floor front window (e) Alterations to flank windows and insertion of additional window (f) Insertion of flank rooflight (g) Insertion of rear door Of approved permission dated 13th March 2000
